URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), for example used over the www (HTTP) service.

Phone.name: Phone
Phone.definition: Collection of information that identifies a phone number, as defined by telecom services.

CustomerService.name: Customer Service
CustomerService.definition: Phone number of the customer service.

AdditionalContactInformation.name: Additional Contact Information
AdditionalContactInformation.definition: Additional information used to facilitate contact with the card acceptor, for instance sales agent name, dispute manager name.
